messages.subject: Tukey Kramer test using JGR
parts: Hello, I'm trying to run a Tukey Kramer test in conjunction with an ANOVA test using r and JGR. I can't figure out how to access and run the tests from the drop down menus in JGR. Any help finding the tests in the drop down menus and/or writing the code for the Tukey Kramer test would be greatly appreciated! Thanks.

messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: Re: Tukey Kramer test using JGR
parts: One way of doing this is, going to Menu, Analysis, Linear Model, enter the parameters, hit continue, then click on post hoc and select from a number of available tests "Tuckey" before proceeding to finally run the model.
